messages:
vivian: Postmortem follow-up: afternoon capacity collapse. I'm starting a short action tracker here so we can close owners and avoid recurring midday patterns. Notes + ask below.

vivian: Observed pattern: warm-up KV misses + sudden token surge -> scheduler queues pile up -> autoscaler latency to add nodes. Immediate goal: short-term guard, medium-term scheduler hardening, long-term quota routing audit.

omar: I can do the quota-routing audit. Owner: omar. ETA: 2026-04-06. Deliverable: mapping doc + failing tenant repro cases. Will add a tiny integration test for per-queue vs per-tenant enforcement.

li: I'll take scheduler hardening. Owner: li. ETA: 2026-04-01. Plan: change lease timeout handling, tighten the backpressure window, and add a feature-flagged dry-run. Proposed patch summary: adjust lease_grace_ms from 1200 -> 800 and add per-replica admission window logging.

dana: Short-term guard: implement emergency reserve pool (5 GPUs) + fast-path eviction policy for best-effort jobs. Owner: dana + infra. ETA: 2026-03-30. Note: we'll gate via rollout flag `ops.reserves.emergency`.

infra-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance window tonight 23:00 UTC may affect canaries. Please coordinate.

vivian: We also need a recurring smoke test: one synthetic client that mimics midday traffic spike every Tue/Thu 14:00 UTC. Owner: li + omar. First run: 2026-03-31. If alerts fire, escalate to oncall and open follow-up.

omar: For the quota routing audit, question: do we treat low-priority batch as a shared pool or allocate a per-queue floor? I prefer a small per-queue minimum to prevent starvation.

li: Per-queue floor sounds right. We'll include override knobs per-tenant. We'll add metrics: queue_floor_usage_pct and queue_starvation_count.

dana: I'll draft the rollout plan for the reserve pool and include a rollback path that reduces reserve to 0 over 10 minutes. Also add a metric to track how often reserve is consumed.

vivian: Can someone own the regression checklist to ensure these changes don't regress latency/cost? Need someone to run before/after on canary.

li: I'll own the regression checklist for the first two weeks and add a benchmark job that runs perf traces and token-cost estimation. ETA: 2026-03-31.

omar: I'll create the Jira epic and link PRs/patches here. Tagging tenants we saw in the incident for repro.

dana: Quick ops note: add an alert for headroom decay over 7 minutes (threshold 90% of target). That should give us earlier paging.

vivian: Action summary (owners + dates):
- quota routing audit (omar) 6#x2014; 2026-04-06
- scheduler hardening (li) 6#x2014; 2026-04-01
- emergency reserve pool rollout (dana + infra) 6#x2014; 2026-03-30
- recurring synthetic spike (li + omar) 6#x2014; 2026-03-31
- regression checklist & canary benchmarks (li) 6#x2014; 2026-03-31

infra-bot: Action tracker updated: 5 open items. Next check-in: 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC.

vivian: Please react with :white_check_mark: once you've created the Jira task and set the due date. I'll hand off the tracker to oncall after two weeks. Thanks everyone.
